_comment: Concrete ids for dynamic page routes, so the dogfood sweep can exercise them instead of skipping them. A literal '[id]' URL only ever proves the 404 path. Every id below points at a REAL row seeded for the local dogfood user m@t.co (6ba6571a-b562-45fd-9247-7e94cce84cde) — see docs/specs/dogfood-report.md. Re-seed after `supabase db reset`; a stale id shows up as a 404, not a silent pass. A dynamic route with no entry here is reported as UNSEEDED rather than dropped, so the coverage gap stays visible.
